Hi Paula — thanks for flagging this. 

We can handle single-conversation removals, but there are a couple of clarifying items so we follow Oakmont's legal and our internal retention controls: 

1) Confirmation that Oakmont requests permanent deletion (irreversible) vs. logical expunge (hidden from exports but retained in cold store for 90 days).
2) Full thread identifier (you provided RID-1903 — can you confirm the first message timestamp: 2026-09-14 08:22:00 PDT?)
3) Any compliance paperwork (signed DSR) — you indicated you have it; please attach to this thread.

Assuming you confirm permanent deletion, our process is: intake -> security approval -> scoped job to remove conversation and derived indices -> generate an audit artifact showing the deletion job id and hash of removed items -> provide you the ticket and removed-item CSV. Typical SLA for scoped removes is 3 business days after approvals. If you need expedited treatment we can request a 24–48h turnaround but that requires SOC/security on-call sign-off.

I've CC'd Steph and Grace from Product & Security for intake and approval flow.

Best,
Aditya Rao
